guide.title: How to use AgroAI Advisor
guide.lead: This page go show you wetin each part of the website dey do and how to use am, one by one.

banner.title: You be new here?
banner.body: Read small guide wey go show you wetin AgroAI Advisor fit do and how to use am.

s1.b: As you log in, you go land for your dashboard. You go see the crop checks wey you don do, today weather and the crops wey you dey plant.

s2.b: For "About your farm", add the crops wey you dey grow and small note. The advisor dey use am make the advice fit your farm.

s3.b: Press "Check crop" to send picture, or "Ask question" to type or talk.

s4.t: Follow the steps, or ask person
s4.b: Read wetin to do. If wahala big or I no sure, send the summary give extension officer.

check.b: Choose the crop, snap the leaf or plant wey dey worry you, and add small word about wetin you see. You go see wetin I see, why I think so, how I sure reach, and wetin to do.

ask.b: Type your question, or hold the microphone button and talk. Ask about pest, planting, or if you fit spray today. You fit correct the words before you send am.

weather.b: Use your location or choose your town to see weather now and for the next 5 days, with simple talk on wetin e mean for your farm.

farm.b: For the dashboard, add your crops and notes. I dey remember your saved checks and recent chat, so the advice go be for your own farm.

account.b: Change how big letters go be, the colour, and whether make answers dey read for mouth. You fit also delete your history or your whole account.

language.b: Use the English and Pidgin buttons for top of the page to change language any time.

photo.title: How to snap good photo
tips: Come close, make the leaf full the picture.
Hold your phone steady and use good daylight.
Snap the part wey dey worry you, no snap the whole farm.
If the photo blur, snap another one. I go tell you if I need clearer one.
Add small word like "leaves dey turn yellow". E dey help.

read.title: How to read the answer
read.body: "How I sure be" dey show how much you fit trust the answer: Sure, Fairly sure or Not sure. "Wetin fit change my mind" na things wey you fit check for your farm. Start with the cheap steps for "Wetin to do". I no dey give chemical measure: follow the label and your extension officer.

limits.title: Wetin you must remember
limits.body: I fit make mistake, and I no fit touch your plants or test your soil. If the plants dey worse fast, or plenty of dem don catch am, go meet extension officer.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.body: We no dey keep your photos. Your account dey keep the answers for your crop checks and your recent chat, and nobody else no fit see dem. You fit delete dem any time for My account.

landing.title: Correct farm help wey you go understand, for English or Pidgin.
landing.lead: Snap picture of the leaf wey dey sick, ask your question with mouth or type am, and you go get advice wey match your weather and your crops. If I no too sure, I go tell you true, and I go talk make you see extension officer.

s1.b: Snap the leaf or plant wey dey worry you. Add small word about wetin you see.

s2.t: I go show you reason, no be only answer
s2.b: You go see wetin I see, why I think so, how I sure reach, and wetin fit change my mind.

s3.b: Follow the easy steps wey no cost money first. If wahala big or I no sure, send the summary go meet extension officer.

example.label: Example of answer
example.see: Leaf dey twist, e get pale yellow and green patches, and the plant small pass the ones wey dey near am.
example.step: Pull the worst plants comot today, burn or bury dem, so whitefly no go carry the sickness go the other plants.
example.note: Na example of how answer dey look. No be real farmer own.

crops.title: Crops wey I sabi well
crops.body: Cassava, yam, maize, plantain, cocoyam and pepper, plus the pests and sickness wey dey common for Akwa Ibom. For other crops, I go give general advice and tell you say I no sabi am reach.

remember.title: Advice wey sabi your farm
remember.body: If you open account, I go remember your town, the crops wey you dey plant, and wetin don happen before, so the advice go be for your own farm. We no dey keep your photos, and you fit delete everything any time.

honest.title: Wetin I no fit do
honest.body: I fit make mistake. I no fit touch your plant or test your soil. For animal, body health, money or law matter, abeg go meet the correct person. I no go ever give you chemical measure: always follow the label and wetin extension officer talk.
